Module protection

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to protection objects.

Classes
  FrontProtectionObject
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, protection)' if protection of type PROTECTION_TYPE_C with the user type belonging to signalUserTypes or switchTypes, is a front protection object for 'path' of type PATH.
  FlankProtectionObject
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, protection)' if protection of type PROTECTION_TYPE_C with the user type belonging to signalUserTypes or switchTypes, is a flank protection object for 'path' of type PATH.
